title: Assess release preflight and qualification
description: Assess readiness at the explicitly selected cheap-preflight or full-qualification boundary. It preserves their different side effects and proof scope and consumes existing package, validation, and assurance contracts rather than defining independent correctness.
inputs: Selected release profile/source/candidate and requested assessment scope.
Required inputs, current projections, actual artifact/check observations, and applicable freshness/deferral decisions.
outputs: Scoped preflight or qualification findings and actual observed results.
Missing, failed, stale, contradicted, unperformed, deferred, or unsupported obligations that limit readiness.
behavior: Use side-effect-light preflight for profile/version/pointer/literal/pending-evidence/input/output/tag defects without credentials or full artifact/public checks.
Reject unauthorized changed current literals, retain baseline drift and historical classifications, and preserve unknown remote state as uncertainty.

For full qualification, assess the exact candidate's required notes, source state, package preview, packed-consumer, archive, security, recovery, and authentication/provenance obligations through their existing owners.
Apply evidence applicability/freshness and explicit owner deferrals; keep nondeferable duties and required fresh public observations intact.
Report readiness only for established scope without making assessment a publication authorization.

failure_behavior.condition: Required support is missing, stale, conflicting, or failed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the blocking obligation and prevent a readiness claim.

failure_behavior.condition: Only cheap preflight, dry-run, source checks, or cached inapplicable evidence is available.
failure_behavior.outcome: Retain that limited observation without claiming full candidate qualification.

failure_behavior.condition: A deferral lacks its required basis or attempts to waive a nondeferable duty.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject reliance on the deferral and report the unmet obligation.
